onboard_ai.onboarding_flow: Explains Onboard AI feature on AI Connect button click, lets user choose Install vs Skip, auto-installs from GitHub via cmd.exe

windows_explorer_parity: Back/Forward/Up/Refresh navigation + clickable Breadcrumb path bar + editable Address bar (Ctrl+L/Alt+D)
Multi-tab browsing (Ctrl+T new tab, Ctrl+W close tab, Ctrl+Tab switch tab, Open folder in new tab)
Quick Access sidebar (Home, Desktop, Downloads, Documents, Pictures, Music, Videos, Recycle Bin) + Pinned Favorites
This PC drive list with volume labels, free/total capacity text, and visual usage bars
Full file operations: Open, Open With, Cut, Copy, Paste, Duplicate (Ctrl+D), New Folder (Ctrl+Shift+N), New File (Ctrl+N), Rename (F2), Recycle (Delete), Permanent Delete (Shift+Delete)
Built-in ZIP archive compression, extraction (with Zip-Slip protection), and ZIP content preview
View modes (Details, List, Large Icons/Thumbnails, Small Icons, Tiles), Category filter, Show Hidden Items, Show File Extensions, Item Checkboxes
Internal & external Windows Explorer Drag-and-Drop (DataFormats.FileDrop) + subfolder drop
Open CMD Here (cmd.exe), Open in Windows Explorer, Copy Path (Ctrl+Shift+C), Copy Name, Windows Properties (Alt+Enter), SHA-256 hash inspector
